name: apc
summary: Atari Punk Console (band-limited): a 555 astable drives a 555 monostable. `width` is the monostable pulse width as an absolute time (Q16 samples), so the duty is width/period and changes with pitch (the authentic cross-coupling). `fm` (audio) scales the frequency (1 + fm/32768) and `width_mod` (control) scales the width (1 + width_mod/32768), the cross-mod inputs. Both edges are band-limited with two polyBLEP corrections (like the `pulse` node), so a swept frequency stays clean. A width past the period clamps to a near-full pulse.
